title: HypoNet Nankai PS: rapid hypocenter determination for the Nankai Trough using physics-informed neural networks with three-dimensional P- and S-wave velocity models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27561v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid and accurate hypocenter determination based on three-dimensional (3D) seismic velocity models is essential for seismic monitoring in subduction zones, yet it remains computationally demanding. HypoNet Nankai, a hypocenter determination package that uses physics-informed neural network (PINN) travel-time inference for a realistic 3D P-wave velocity model of the Nankai Trough subduction zone, was designed to address this problem, but supported only P-wave arrival times. Here, we present HypoNet Nankai PS, which extends the framework to both P- and S-wave travel times. We first constructed an S-wave velocity model from the existing P-wave model using empirical conversion relations for marine sediments and the crust. translated_title: HypoNet Nankai PS：利用基于物理信息神经网络的三维P波和S波速度模型实现南海海槽震源快速定位
translated_abstract: 基于三维（3D）地震速度模型的快速准确震源定位对于俯冲带的地震监测至关重要，但其计算需求很高。HypoNet Nankai是一个震源定位软件包，采用物理信息神经网络（PINN）走时推断技术，针对南海海槽俯冲带的真实三维P波速度模型进行计算，旨在解决这一问题，但此前仅支持P波到时。本研究提出了HypoNet Nankai PS，将该框架扩展至P波和S波走时。我们首先利用海洋沉积物和地壳的经验转换关系，从现有P波模型构建了S波速度模型。由于所得S波速度结构的速度较低，导致走时梯度明显更陡峭，原先为P波速度结构设计的PINN训练流程已不足以（应对这一挑战）。
tldr: 本研究将基于物理信息神经网络的震源定位框架HypoNet Nankai扩展为HypoNet Nankai PS，通过从P波模型构建S波速度模型并改进训练方法以适应更陡峭的S波走时梯度，实现了南海海槽俯冲带同时利用P波和S波到时的快速震源定位。
en_tdlr: This study extends the PINN-based hypocenter determination framework HypoNet Nankai to HypoNet Nankai PS, which incorporates both P- and S-wave travel times by constructing an S-wave velocity model from the existing P-wave model and adapting the training procedure to handle steeper S-wave travel-time gradients, enabling rapid earthquake location in the Nankai Trough subduction zone.
